Title: Generally Available: Troubleshoot Disk Performance with Azure Copilot

Body.Content:
The Disk Performance Troubleshooting Capability for Azure Copilot is now available in General Availability as a part of the Copilot in Azure General Availability. Now, you can use Azure Copilot to optimize your disk performance effortlessly. 

Azure offers a rich variety of disk metrics, providing insights into the performance of your Virtual Machines (VMs) and disks. These metrics help you diagnose performance issues when your application requires higher performance than what you have configured for the VMs and disks. 

Azure Copilot further enhances your experience by analyzing these metrics to resolve performance issues on your behalf, along with providing guided recommendations for optimizing VM and disk performance to improve your application's experience. 

For more information on the Disk Performance capability for Azure Copilot, refer to the Public Documentation: Troubleshoot Disk Performance using Microsoft Copilot in Azure.
